<thought>We need to locate the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the given target molecule (the SMILES shown in the previous answer), yields the listed precursors. This template corresponds to the DIBAL‑H reduction of an ester to an aldehyde (breaking a C–O bond and reducing the C=O bond order). We'll search the template catalog for reactions that break an ester and form an aldehyde, then retrieve the template ID and map the reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde"],
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
